BiblicalUsage: Chushan-rishathaim was the king of Mesopotamia who held Israel eight years. Judges 3:8 says the Lord "sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia," and Judges 3:10 says the Spirit of the Lord came upon Othniel, who went out to war, and the Lord delivered the king into his hand.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, the eight years and the one deliverance belong together: God sold Israel into the hand of their enemy for their sin, and God raised up the judge who broke that hand.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
